simple.summary: נְסַךְ (nᵉçak) means a libation First listed occurrence: Ezra 7 17.

definitions.full: H5261. nesak [ נְסַךְ ] noun [masculine] drink-offering ( ᵑ7 Syriac; compare Biblical Hebrew); — plural suffix נִסְכֵּיהוֺן Ezra 7:17 (+ מִנְחָֽתְהוֺן , etc.). נסק see סלק .
